name: AL Language Coverage Tests (Try Writes Allowed)
brief: Probes that run with the service-tier setting DisableWriteInsideTryFunctions=false.
description: BC's service tier denies a write inside a TryFunction by default (DisableWriteInsideTryFunctions=true, the container default); SaaS runs with false. The main coverage app runs in deny mode (error TryFunctionWrite). This app runs in its own CI job that sets the value to false through bc-linux's server_settings input, and holds only the tests that need that mode.
